name: cross-dimension-revenue
description: Cross-dimensional grouped revenue and multi-metric aggregation

queries.name: region-category-revenue
queries.sql: SELECT region, category, SUM(amount) FROM events GROUP BY region, category ORDER BY region, category

queries.name: region-status-revenue
queries.sql: SELECT region, status, SUM(amount) FROM events GROUP BY region, status ORDER BY region, status

queries.name: category-status-orders
queries.sql: SELECT category, status, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY category, status ORDER BY category, status

queries.name: region-category-metrics
queries.sql: SELECT region, category, SUM(amount), COUNT(amount) FROM events GROUP BY region, category ORDER BY region, category
